name: local_whisper
description: Transcribe an audio file through the compose-internal local STT HTTP service. Returns full transcript and word/timing records when available. Requires no API key.

audio_path.description: Absolute path to the audio file as mounted in the STT service (webm, mp3, wav, m4a, etc.)

language.description: Optional ISO language code e.g. 'en'. Omit for auto-detect.

model.description: Local Whisper model name. Defaults to tiny unless LOCAL_WHISPER_MODEL is set.
